name: Duffel Stays
auth_notes: Same Bearer token as Duffel Flights. Static, no refresh. Test: duffel_test_*, Live: duffel_live_*.
coverage_notes: 1M+ hotel properties worldwide. Marriott, Hilton, Shangri-La, IHG, Westin, JW Marriott. Commission-share model.
pricing_notes: Commission-share model. You earn from bookings, not pay per booking. Price shown is the hotel rate. Free search.

quirks.issue: Search requires latitude/longitude coordinates, not city codes
quirks.workaround: Use duffel_stays_suggest or duffel_stays_list_accommodation to resolve names to coordinates

quirks.issue: Quotes have expires_at timestamp and can expire
quirks.workaround: Check expires_at before booking. If expired, re-search and create a new quote

quirks.issue: Phone number must be E.164 format (+1234567890)
quirks.workaround: Validate and prepend country code before sending
Inform user if check-in date is more than 330 days out
Split into multiple bookings for longer stays
Ensure query string is at least 3 characters before calling suggest

booking_notes: 4-step flow: Search -> Fetch Rates -> Quote (locks price) -> Book. No passport needed. Guest needs given_name, family_name, email, phone (E.164). Can pass loyalty_programme_account_number and accommodation_special_requests.
